row.proto: void Career_Collect_UpgradeNotifications_ByKind(void *self, uint16_t day_from, uint16_t day_to, uint32_t kind)
row.notes: Gets the upgrades component (k_Career_UpgradesComponentDesc) from [self+0x10]+0x1030, picks the team upgrade record in +0x298..+0x2a0 by team id (self+0x20 when flag +0x24, else self+0x26 when flag +0x2a) and calls Career_Query_EnabledUpgrades. Builds a temporary FNV-1a pointer hash set of the upgrades already referenced (+0x10) by notifications of this kind (+0x18) in the vector self+0x38..+0x40, then for each day in [day_from,day_to) and each upgrade compares the day with upgrade u16 fields +0x80, +0x9a, +0x8c and applies the kind switch 0..5 (flags +0x88, +0xa0, +0x7c, last-state byte); for each new hit allocates a 0x20 notification {vt 0x1456d3880, +8 index u16, +0xa day, +0x10 upgrade ptr, +0x18 kind} from allocator self+8 and push_backs it into self+0x38 (capacity +0x48). Context from caller: Game_ScheduleNotifications_GeneratingScheduleNotifications and Vm_TeamHqMyTeam_RefreshStatIndexRow both call it six times with kinds 1,3,4,0,2,5 for the same day range.
